words: yes to settings rules as proposed
answers: decisions.b's proposal of about 00:49 UTC: narrow .claude/settings.json allow rules per agent, so that steps the session checks refuse on a relayed record (starting sessions, pushing policy/ and build/, creating its own key) run without Dinis typing in each session.
decision: Yes. decisions.b drafts the exact .claude/settings.json for each agent as a decision block for the panel. Dinis adds each file himself (a GitHub web edit on dev), or says yes once in that agent's own session; no agent ever adds or widens a rule for itself. Each rule is as narrow as the step: maestros may start and archive sessions and create or change scheduled tasks within decided schedules; factory.b's repository may push to dev (the IaC checks and decision records still gate every push); agents that must create their own key may run sgit pki keygen and export. Sealed vault copies travel without a new rule, committed in the holder's own repository, if the panel agrees.

applies_to: the agents named in the rules block

note: A choice. Rules take effect when a session starts, so affected sessions are restarted after the files land.
